messages:
emma_alliances: Quick thread — partner (NimbleHW) wants a joint announcement that touches cloud marketplace listing, a hardware bundle, and an SI co-sell play. We need a short-running ops plan: who owns pipeline mapping, demo cadence, and announcement sequencing?

aj_sales: +1. prefer a staggered announce: marketplace listing first, then joint press + HW availability 2w later. reduces support spikes.

karim_se: Agree on stagger. For co-sell we need clear lead ownership rules — especially for accounts with shared reps. Proposing: SI claims inbound leads if they originated from SI demo or co-sell marketing; otherwise partner-marketable leads go to Redwood field.

lia_solutions: Quick sample mapping CSV I used previously:
```
account_id,origin_channel,claimed_by,notes
100234,partner_demo,SI-X,SI owns follow-up
100235,marketplace,redwood_field,handle via AE queue
```
Use this pattern for the first sweep and we'll iterate.

devon_legal: Heads-up: partner marketing materials must include the approved joint logo lockup. Also need partner consent for case studies before publish. I'll share the template.

suz_partnerpm: We can commit to marketplace listing by 04/10. Hardware shipment ETA 04/24. SI partner wants a joint demo week of 04/15 — does that block the timeline?

emma_alliances: Thanks Suz. Demo week on 04/15 is fine if marketplace listing is live; it lets us reference the SKU in slides. So timeline: 04/10 marketplace soft-live (docs + listing), 04/15 co-sell demo week, 04/24 public HW availability + press.

aj_sales: Small ask: can we bucket accounts into three priorities so SI knows where to push? Suggest buckets: strategic (top 50), target (next 200), broad (marketplace). SI handles strategic + target claims; broad goes to marketplace inbound.

karim_se: For automation, we can add a tag in CRM: "partner_campaign=nimble_0424" then a rule: if lead.source=SI_demo -> assign to SI queue, else if lead.source=marketplace -> AE queue. I can drop the rule into SFDC.

lia_solutions: I'll own demo kit and sample prompts for the joint demo. Can folks review the runbook before 04/08? I'll post link to the deck + kit here once ready.

devon_legal: I'll publish the consent template by EOD and add the approved boilerplate. Suz, pls confirm partner branding assets by 04/05.

partner-bot: Reminder: scheduled sync with NimbleHW PM on 04/03 10:00 PDT — calendar invite sent.

emma_alliances: Action items recap:
- karim: SFDC routing rule + tag (due 04/05)
- lia: demo kit + runbook (draft by 04/08)
- devon: marketing consent + boilerplate (04/03)
- suz: confirm branding assets (04/05)
- aj: prepare bucket list for top 50 strategic accounts (04/06)

aj_sales: I'll share the strategic account list in a follow-up message. :thumbsup:

karim_se: One more ops note — if SI claims an account but we detect marketplace purchase within 30 days, auto-escalate to revenue ops to reconcile crediting.

emma_alliances: Good call. I'll add that to the play doc. Anything else?

lia_solutions: NVM from me.

suz_partnerpm: All good on my side — will upload logos and confirm demo resources by 04/05.

emma_alliances: Thanks team. I'll convert this into the shared playbook and ping when it's in Confluence. :sparkles:
